4. Management commentary

Northstar Components manufactured industrial electrical components in FY2024. The fictional business operated
with a distributor-focused sales model. The named risks in Section 5 are the only risks explicitly disclosed in this
report.

5. Risks explicitly disclosed

- Supplier delivery delays

- Warranty claims exposure

- Distributor demand variability

The report identifies the risks above as potential risks. It does not provide probabilities or quantified loss estimates
for these risks.

6. Scope and limitations

This report relates only to Northstar Components and FY2024. Amounts in this report must not be attributed to
another company or another reporting year. This report does not disclose market share, stock-market valuation, or
audited financial results.

All figures, names, business events, and risk descriptions in this document are invented for FinAssist AI testing.
